lines.text: How do computers around the world agree on one answer, even when the network is shaky?
Consensus means many machines agree on one shared truth, even if some crash or disconnect.
lines.title: The goal

lines.text: Popular methods like Raft rely on one leader. If it is slow or cut off, everything stalls until a new leader is elected.
lines.title: Leader problem

lines.text: In 2020, a faulty network switch made a Cloudflare dashboard run eighty times slower for six hours.
lines.title: What went wrong in 2020

lines.text: In QuePaxa, proposers send ideas to recorders, then adopt the best-ranked idea they see, instead of fighting.
lines.title: How QuePaxa works

lines.text: Cloudflare says over ninety-five percent of decisions are made fast by the leader.
lines.title: Cloudflare's Meerkat

lines.text: When the leader fails, the system slows down, but it never stops.
lines.title: Takeaways
